meta.title: Model Gateway
meta.description: One plugin for every points-for-models platform: WorkBuddy, CodeArts, Meoo, SCNet, WPS Lingxi and SenseTime Raccoon. Shared login and account pool, balances, model catalog and switches, auto check-in; enabled models appear in the DSH model picker. Auto mode falls back along a platform + account + model priority chain when a candidate is rate-limited, out of quota, or signed out.
